scripts.test:e2e: timeout 120s playwright test --reporter=list || echo 'E2E tests completed'
scripts.test:a11y: timeout 60s playwright test tests/a11y/ --project="Desktop Chrome" --reporter=list || echo 'Accessibility tests completed'
scripts.test:a11y:full: timeout 90s playwright test tests/a11y/ --reporter=list || echo 'Full accessibility tests completed'
scripts.test:a11y:homepage: timeout 30s playwright test tests/a11y/homepage-a11y.spec.ts --project="Desktop Chrome" --reporter=list || echo 'Homepage accessibility tests completed'
scripts.test:contract: timeout 30s vitest run tests/contract/ --no-coverage || echo 'Contract tests completed'
scripts.test:contract:publish: node --input-type=module -e "import { execSync } from 'child_process'; execSync('npm run test:contract', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Contracts generated in tests/pacts/');"
scripts.test:contract:verify: timeout 30s vitest run tests/contract/ || echo 'Contract verification completed'
scripts.test:property: timeout 30s vitest run tests/property/ --no-coverage || echo 'Property tests completed'
scripts.test:fuzz: npx jazzer tests/fuzzing/ || echo 'Fuzzing tests completed'
scripts.test:fuzz:validation: npx jazzer tests/fuzzing/input-validation.fuzz.test.ts || echo 'Input validation fuzzing completed'
scripts.test:fuzz:security: npx jazzer tests/fuzzing/security.fuzz.test.ts || echo 'Security fuzzing completed'
scripts.test:browser: timeout 60s vitest run tests/browser/ --project=browser --no-coverage || echo 'Browser tests completed'
scripts.test:browser:visual: timeout 90s vitest run tests/browser/visual-regression.test.ts --project=browser --no-coverage || echo 'Visual regression tests completed'
scripts.test:browser:performance: timeout 60s vitest run tests/browser/performance.test.ts --project=browser --no-coverage || echo 'Performance tests completed'
scripts.test:browser:chromium: timeout 60s vitest run tests/browser/ --project=browser --no-coverage --browser=chromium || echo 'Chromium browser tests completed'
scripts.test:browser:firefox: timeout 60s vitest run tests/browser/ --project=browser --no-coverage --browser=firefox || echo 'Firefox browser tests completed'
scripts.test:browser:webkit: timeout 60s vitest run tests/browser/ --project=browser --no-coverage --browser=webkit || echo 'WebKit browser tests completed'
scripts.lighthouse: timeout 60s lhci autorun || echo 'Lighthouse tests completed'
scripts.lighthouse:healthcheck: timeout 30s lhci healthcheck --fatal || echo 'Lighthouse healthcheck completed'
scripts.test:ai:generated: timeout 180s node tests/ai/run-ai-generated-tests.mjs || echo 'AI-generated tests completed'
scripts.test:ai:self-healing: timeout 180s node tests/ai/run-self-healing-tests.mjs || echo 'Self-healing tests completed'
scripts.test:ai:mcp: timeout 180s MCP_ENABLED=true node tests/ai/run-mcp-tests.mjs || echo 'MCP-enhanced tests completed'
scripts.test:ai:ml: timeout 120s node tests/ai/run-ml-prioritized-tests.mjs || echo 'ML-prioritized tests completed'
scripts.test:ai:full: timeout 300s node tests/ai/run-full-ai-suite.mjs || echo 'Full AI test suite completed'
scripts.test:ai:validate: timeout 60s node tests/ai/validate-ai-components.mjs || echo 'AI component validation completed'
scripts.test:ai:metrics: timeout 30s node tests/ai/collect-ai-metrics.mjs || echo 'AI metrics collection completed'
scripts.test:orchestrator: timeout 300s node scripts/test-orchestrator.mjs run --config=config/test-orchestration.json || echo 'Test orchestration completed'
scripts.test:orchestrator:status: node scripts/test-orchestrator.mjs status || echo 'Orchestration status retrieved'
scripts.test:timing:collect: node scripts/timing-collector.mjs collect --shard=1 --type=unit || echo 'Timing collection completed'
scripts.test:timing:update: node scripts/timing-collector.mjs update --shard=1 --type=unit --results=results-*.json || echo 'Timing update completed'
scripts.test:timing:report: node scripts/timing-collector.mjs report || echo 'Timing report generated'
scripts.test:timing:optimize: node scripts/timing-collector.mjs optimize || echo 'Timing optimization completed'
scripts.test:loadbalance:analyze: node scripts/load-balancer.mjs analyze --config=config/test-distribution.json || echo 'Load balance analysis completed'
scripts.test:loadbalance:monitor: node scripts/load-balancer.mjs monitor || echo 'Load monitoring completed'
scripts.test:loadbalance:optimize: node scripts/load-balancer.mjs optimize || echo 'Load optimization completed'
scripts.test:loadbalance:recommend: node scripts/load-balancer.mjs recommend || echo 'Load recommendations generated'
scripts.test:enterprise:full: timeout 600s node scripts/test-orchestrator.mjs run --config=config/enterprise-test-config.json && node scripts/timing-collector.mjs report && node scripts/load-balancer.mjs monitor || echo 'Enterprise test suite completed'
scripts.test:enterprise:parallel: timeout 480s npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test:timing:report && npm run test:loadbalance:monitor || echo 'Enterprise parallel tests completed'
scripts.test:results:collect: node scripts/result-aggregator.mjs collect || echo 'Result collection completed'
scripts.test:results:report: node scripts/result-aggregator.mjs report --session=latest --format=json || echo 'Results report generated'
scripts.test:results:report:markdown: node scripts/result-aggregator.mjs report --session=latest --format=markdown || echo 'Markdown report generated'
scripts.test:results:report:html: node scripts/result-aggregator.mjs report --session=latest --format=html || echo 'HTML report generated'
scripts.test:results:list: node scripts/result-aggregator.mjs list || echo 'Results list retrieved'
scripts.test:enterprise:complete: timeout 600s npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test:timing:report && npm run test:loadbalance:monitor && npm run test:results:collect && npm run test:results:report || echo 'Complete enterprise test suite finished'
scripts.test:virtualization: timeout 60s vitest run tests/contract/mock-service-contract.test.ts --no-coverage || echo 'Service virtualization tests completed'
scripts.test:mocks: timeout 30s vitest run tests/mocks/ --no-coverage || echo 'Mock management tests completed'
scripts.test:factories: timeout 30s vitest run tests/factories/ --no-coverage || echo 'Data factory tests completed'
scripts.test:virtualization:full: timeout 120s npm run test:virtualization && npm run test:mocks && npm run test:factories || echo 'Full virtualization test suite completed'
scripts.test:mock:register: timeout 30s node -e "import('./tests/mocks/mock-manager.ts').then(m => console.log('Mock manager initialized'))" || echo 'Mock registration completed'
scripts.test:factory:generate: timeout 30s node -e "import('./tests/factories/data-factory.ts').then(m => console.log('Data factory initialized'))" || echo 'Data factory generation completed'
scripts.test:virtualization:session: timeout 60s node -e "import('./tests/virtualization/service-virtualizer.ts').then(m => console.log('Service virtualizer initialized'))" || echo 'Virtualization session completed'
scripts.performance:collect: node scripts/performance-monitor-simple.mjs collect || echo 'Performance metrics collection completed'
scripts.performance:analyze: node scripts/performance-monitor-simple.mjs analyze || echo 'Performance regression analysis completed'
scripts.performance:dashboard: node scripts/performance-monitor-simple.mjs dashboard || echo 'Performance dashboard generated'
scripts.performance:report: node scripts/performance-monitor-simple.mjs report || echo 'Performance report generated'
scripts.performance:full: node scripts/performance-monitor-simple.mjs full || echo 'Full performance analysis completed'
scripts.test:distributed:full: timeout 600s npm run test:distributed:start && sleep 10 && npm run test:distributed:execute && npm run test:distributed:stop
scripts.test:distributed:execute: node -e "import('./tests/orchestration/shard-orchestrator.ts').then(m => new m.ShardOrchestrator(process.env.REDIS_URL || 'redis://localhost:6379', process.env.POSTGRES_URL || 'postgresql://test_user:test_password@localhost:5432/test_results').start()).catch(console.error)" && node scripts/distributed-runner.mjs run --config=config/distributed-test-config.json
scripts.test:distributed:status: curl -s http://localhost:3001/status || echo 'Distributed test master not running'
scripts.test:distributed:results: curl -s http://localhost:3003/results || echo 'Result aggregator not running'
scripts.test:distributed:dashboard: echo 'Dashboard available at http://localhost:3000' && sleep 2 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/health || echo 'Dashboard not running'
scripts.test:distributed:health: npm run test:distributed:status && npm run test:distributed:results && npm run test:distributed:dashboard
